args: In lcms/src/cmsopt.c, what is the safest intended fix for OptimizeByResampling allowing nGridPoints == 1 from _cmsReasonableGridpointsByColorspace? Should it reject optimization (return FALSE) or clamp to 2, and are there conventions/tests indicating expected handling of explicit cmsFLAGS_GRIDPOINTS values below 2? Also assess cleanup/state concerns if returning FALSE immediately after line 671.

The ASan report shows a heap-buffer-overflow in TetrahedralInterp16 during FixWhiteMisalignment after OptimizeByResampling allocates a 3-D one-point cmsStageAllocCLut16bit. _cmsReasonableGridpointsByColorspace returns the explicit GRIDPOINTS field, including 1. At this stage OptimizeByResampling has only inspected formats/colorspaces and computed nGridPoints; Src has not yet been modified or transferred. The vulnerability statement says OptimizeByResampling must reject or clamp an explicitly requested grid below the interpolator minimum. I am considering a local `if (nGridPoints < 2) return FALSE;` before allocation, preserving the original pipeline and allowing fallback rather than silently changing an explicit caller request.
